dedupe_keys.name: data in experimental stand alone microgrid

description: The PIMENT Laboratory shares measurements from its first experimental microgrid at Roche Plate, in the isolated Mafate area of Reunion Island. The Micro Reseau Mafate project uses this installation to investigate electricity supply for communities outside the main grid. The Zenodo file inventory separates solar-plant measurements, meteorological data and demand from three houses, alongside a README. Five 7z archives provide the data through a public repository download route. The deposit is licensed CC BY 4.0 and is free to access. The repository description does not state the measurement interval, sampling frequency or internal file formats, and the archives were not opened during this metadata review. Those details must be checked before calibrating a model. The combination of weather, generation and household demand is suitable for testing microgrid dispatch and storage-sizing assumptions. It complements model-pypsa as potential site-specific input; no published PyPSA adapter was established.
